title: normalizeAgentDoc: coerce/reject wrong-typed properties scalars (1367 residual)
description:
Verification of task 1367 (commit 1c9a36e, 'validate/normalize structural agent-tool input') found one residual gap in the doc_load / file_load_fla doc-replacement validator that is within the 1367 charter's stated doc_load goal ('wrong-typed fields -> rejected-with-error or normalized to a safe doc').

GAP: normalizeAgentDoc (packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts ~L301) backfills MISSING properties via createDocumentProperties(propsIn) and forces scenes/library/id invariants, but it does NOT coerce or reject a properties OBJECT that is PRESENT with wrong-typed scalar fields. createDocumentProperties(overrides) (packages/core/src/model/document.ts L28) spreads overrides LAST, so a bad value wins over the default:
  doc_load({ document: { properties: { width: 'wide', frameRate: {}, backgroundColor: 123 } } })
  -> history.present carries properties.width === 'wide' (a string), frameRate === {}, backgroundColor === 123.

This is the same class as 1363 (malformed structural input reaching history.present) but a step short of an uncaught throw. Downstream corruption is concrete: the SWF compiler reads props.width/props.height in compiler/assemble.ts (writer.assemble(props.frameRate, frameCount, props.width, props.height)) and the header pass computes the stage RECT in twips as width*20 -> NaN for a string width, producing a corrupt SWF header. So this is silent doc/output corruption, exactly what 1367 set out to prevent.

The 1367 tests only cover the MISSING-properties case (registry.test.ts L1916 'BACKFILLS missing/malformed properties' omits properties entirely) and the valid-override-VALUES case (L1935); the present-but-wrong-typed-scalar case is untested and admitted.

FIX (suggested): in normalizeAgentDoc, before overlaying, filter propsIn to drop/replace wrong-typed known scalars (width/height/frameRate as finite numbers, backgroundColor as a string, the boolean snap flags as booleans, rulerUnits in its enum) so createDocumentProperties' defaults win when the incoming value is the wrong type. Keep it normalize-to-safe (not throw) to match the existing 'thin doc -> safe doc' behavior for doc_load, and keep grid/guides handling intact.

ACCEPTANCE: a doc_load (and file_load_fla) with garbage properties scalars yields properties.width/height/frameRate of type number (finite), backgroundColor a string; add a registry.test.ts case asserting it; valid override values still preserved (L1935 stays green).

NOT in scope / verified OK by the same audit: doc_load non-object rejection, scenes/library backfill, stage_update sanitizeDisplayObjectUpdates (wrong-typed scalar rejected, garbage colorEffect rejected, unknown structural keys stripped), timeline_set_tween typeof guards, file_load_fla malformed-base64/garbage-bytes clean error (nothing pushed). All agent-protocol (110) + authoring-ui (1210) unit suites green at 1c9a36e. jsfl_run.source + *Result z.unknown left loose intentionally per 1367.
